'''September 2001 Nashville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament in September 2001. It is known from Steven Lewis's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2988">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-24-steven-sucks-at-trsd2988/ steven-sucks-at-trs], DeckTech (Steven "Sir Yoda" Lewis, 24 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-24-steven-sucks-at-trsd2988/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' September 2001
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
